description:

The lightweight material does not put pressure on the dog, so that your dog can quickly accept its new

Each nylon strap adopts a special 8-shaped stitching technology, so that the dog harness can be firmer and will not easily fall off. In addition, each dog harness has a safety buckle, which can be quickly closed and held firmly, and can be released quickly under manual operation, also it is easy to put on and take off. Prevent dogs from being

Perfect Control: Each dog harness with a 4 ft/1.2 m dog leash, the material is made of nylon, the same as the dog harness. The length allows you to better control your dog and create a comfortable and safe traction distance, and it complies with most dog walk regulations in parks, you will not worry about the loss of your dog. The swivel hook on the leash satisfies the dog to be able to explore 360° without worrying about the leash entanglement

Made with high-quality, natural ingredients, it features a moist, broth-rich consistency that makes it a delicious and highly palatable meal, in addition to being an excellent source of hydration.

Ingredients and Their Benefits:
Chicken:

High-Quality Protein: Chicken is an excellent source of protein, which is essential for building and repairing muscle tissue and maintaining overall body strength.

Essential Amino Acids: It contains the necessary amino acids that cats require to maintain healthy fur, skin, and claws, as well as to support vital organ functions.

Easy to Digest: Chicken is a protein that is easy for a cat's digestive system to process and absorb.

Salmon:

Omega Fatty Acids: Salmon is a rich source of Omega-3 and Omega-6 fatty acids, which play a crucial role in promoting healthy skin and a soft, shiny coat.

Heart and Joint Health: These fatty acids help reduce inflammation, supporting joint health and contributing to a healthy cardiovascular system.

Vitamins and Minerals: Salmon provides a range of vitamins and minerals like Vitamin D and certain B vitamins, which support bone and nervous system health.

Broth:

Superior Hydration: Since cats often do not drink enough water on their own, the presence of broth in this food significantly helps increase their fluid intake. This prevents dehydration and contributes to urinary tract and kidney health.

Flavor Enhancement: The broth is added to enhance the flavor, making the meal more appealing to cats.

Overall Product Benefits:
Urinary Tract Health: The high moisture content helps prevent common urinary tract issues in cats.

Shiny Coat and Healthy Skin: The combination of chicken and salmon provides the essential proteins and fatty acids needed for a healthy, lustrous coat.

Irresistible Taste: The natural flavor of chicken and salmon in broth makes this product a favorite choice, even for picky eaters.

No Artificial Preservatives or Colors: This food is made using only natural ingredients, making it a healthy and safe choice.

name: Dubba Chicken with Shrimp in Broth, 85g
description:
Chicken with Shrimp in Broth 85 g Wet food for Adult Cats Dubba Cans

Dubba Cans Chicken with Shrimp in Broth is a premium wet cat food designed for adult felines. This product comes in a convenient 85g can, offering a complete and balanced meal. The recipe features two high-quality protein sources: real chicken and tender shrimp, both submerged in a savory, light broth. Unlike many traditional wet foods, this one focuses on a broth-based formula, which helps to keep cats hydrated. The texture is designed to be highly palatable, with recognizable chunks of meat and shrimp that cats find appealing. The product is made without artificial colors, flavors, or preservatives, ensuring a natural and healthy meal. Its gentle formulation is easy to digest, making it suitable for even sensitive stomachs.

Ingredients and Their Benefits
Chicken: As the primary ingredient, chicken is an excellent source of lean protein, essential for maintaining strong muscles, a healthy coat, and overall vitality. It's highly digestible and provides the amino acids cats need for energy and cellular function.

Shrimp: This ingredient adds a unique flavor and an additional source of protein. Shrimp is rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, including iodine and selenium, which support thyroid function and immune health. The novelty of shrimp can also encourage picky eaters to finish their meal.

Broth: The light, savory broth serves multiple important purposes. Most significantly, it significantly increases a cat's water intake. Many cats don't drink enough water on their own, and this broth helps prevent dehydration and supports urinary tract health, which is a common concern for felines.

Taurine: This is a crucial amino acid for cats. It's often supplemented in cat food because cats can't produce it on their own. Taurine is vital for maintaining healthy vision, heart function, and reproductive health.

Vitamins and Minerals: This product is fortified with essential vitamins (like Vitamin E) and minerals to ensure it's a complete and balanced diet. These nutrients support everything from a strong immune system to healthy skin and coat.

- *Natural*: implies minimal processing and no artificial ingredients

When reading labels, consider the following ¹ ² ³:
- Check the ingredient list for added sugars, artificial preservatives, and allergens
- Compare nutritional values between similar products
- Be mindful of serving sizes and the number of servings per container
- Look for certifications like "USDA Organic" or "Non-GMO" if you prioritize specific production methods

name: Trovet Plus Adult Cat Intestinal Hydrolysed Fish, 2.5 kg
description:
Complete, hypoallergenic dietary food for cats with gastro-intestinal disorders

Intestinal is a complete dietary food for cats to support the gastrointestinal tract and the dryfood can also be used as hypoallergenic food. The use of rice as a carbohydrate source makes this food highly digestible and the addition of both fermentable and non-fermentable fibres promote a healthy gastrointestinal tract.

Furthermore, the number of ingredients used is as little as possible, in order to keep the stress on the digestive tract low and the dryfood also minimise the risk of an allergic reaction. Intestinal dry food contains fish protein hydrolysate as animal protein source. Next to the positive effect on digestion, the hydrolysed proteins also have a very low allergenicity. The added fatty acids are able to downregulate inflammatory reactions, which is desirable in cats with an intestinal inflammation or atopy.

​

  • Hydrolyzed white fish protein: Reduces food allergies and supports smooth digestion.
  • Digestive system care: Helps restore intestinal balance and nutrient absorption.

description:
Chicken with Salmon 5×15 g Treat for Cats Dubba

Liquid or creamy cat treats are highly popular snacks that offer several distinct advantages for feline health and well-being:

Hydration Boost: The most significant benefit is their high moisture content. Since many cats do not drink enough water, these treats provide an enjoyable and effortless way to increase their daily fluid intake, supporting kidney and urinary tract health.

Ease of Consumption: Their smooth, lickable texture makes them ideal for senior cats (who may have dental issues) and young kittens transitioning to solid foods, as they are very easy to chew and digest.

Medication Administration: Due to their strong appeal and palatability, liquid treats are an excellent vehicle for easily disguising crushed pills or liquid medications, simplifying the process of medicating your cat.

Appetite Stimulation: The appealing aroma and delicious taste make them a great option for encouraging the appetite of sick cats or those who are refusing their regular food.

Bond Strengthening: Feeding them directly from the tube or your finger creates positive, intimate moments that significantly strengthen the bond and trust between you and your cat.

Hypoallergenic
No Sugar

Non GMO
No pork
Grain-Free

name: Padovan Cat Grass
description:
Cats love to eat certain fresh grasses that often help improve the functioning of their immune system. When swallowed hair from cleaning causes irritation to the stomach mucosae, fresh grass helps cats to regurgitate the balls of fur.

METHOD OF USE

Remove the bag of seeds from the container and put two centimetres of substrate to one side. Evenly distribute the seeds over the whole surface and then cover them with the substrate set aside. Gently tamp the whole surface and dampen with two glasses of water, taking care not to move the seeds. Place the box in a place with plenty of light at approx. 18/20? C, keeping the substrate moist. The seeds will sprout after a few days and when the grass is approx. eight centimetres high it can be put at the disposal of your cat.

description:
Fungus detector for pets


A pet fungus detector is a device used to detect fungi on your pet's skin. It works by emitting ultraviolet light, which causes the fungus to glow.

Features of pet fungus detector:
Easy to use: just turn it on and point it at your pet's skin.
Accurate: Shows you even the smallest spots of fungus.
Fast: gives you results in seconds.
Safe: Does not harm your pet.
VERSATILE: Can be used on all types of pets, including dogs, cats and rabbits.


Benefits:
Early detection of fungi: Early detection of fungi helps you treat your pet faster and prevents the spread of infection.
Peace of Mind: Gives you peace of mind by knowing whether or not your pet has fungus.
Save money: Early detection of fungi can help you save money by reducing treatment costs.

How to use pet fungus detector:
Turn off the lights in the room.
Turn on your pet fungus detector.
Point the light at your pet's skin.
Look for spots of fluorescence (glowing).
If you find any fluorescent spots, take your pet to the vet immediately.

name: Plastic Pet Bowl - Blue, 22cm
description:
pet food or water bowl designed with a cute cat-ear aesthetic. These bowls are commonly used for cats but can also be suitable for small animals like hamsters or guinea pigs. 
Key Features & Design
Whiskered Cat Design: The front of the bowl often features etched whiskers and a small nose, complemented by two pointed ears at the top rim.
  • Ergonomic Shape: Many versions of this bowl have a raised or tilted design to help protect a pet's neck and spine by allowing them to eat in a more natural position.
  • Spill-Resistant: The deep, rounded interior is designed to minimize food spills and mess during feeding.
  • Materials: These bowls are typically made from durable ABS plastic, ceramic, or stoneware. Some variants feature a removable stainless steel inner bowl.

  • Cat Dog bowls with automatic water bottle: 2 in 1 feeder. One stainless steel food bowl, one plastic bowl with automatic water bottle.   • Safe and Non-Toxic Material: High quality stainless bowl + PP bowl base + 500ml non-toxic plastic bottle. Protect your pet's health. Reminder: We just changed to a better quality stainless steel bowl, please clean it before use.

name: Rechargeable Pets UV Light
description:
Fungus detector for pets


A pet fungus detector is a device used to detect fungi on your pet's skin. It works by emitting ultraviolet light, which causes the fungus to glow.

Features of pet fungus detector:
Easy to use: just turn it on and point it at your pet's skin.
Accurate: Shows you even the smallest spots of fungus.
Fast: gives you results in seconds.
Safe: Does not harm your pet.
VERSATILE: Can be used on all types of pets, including dogs, cats and rabbits.


Benefits:
Early detection of fungi: Early detection of fungi helps you treat your pet faster and prevents the spread of infection.
Peace of Mind: Gives you peace of mind by knowing whether or not your pet has fungus.
Save money: Early detection of fungi can help you save money by reducing treatment costs.

How to use pet fungus detector:
Turn off the lights in the room.
Turn on your pet fungus detector.
Point the light at your pet's skin.
Look for spots of fluorescence (glowing).
If you find any fluorescent spots, take your pet to the vet immediately.

name: Doggy Potion Ear Cleaner - 120ml
description:
DETAILS

An all-natural ear wash for cats and dogs with aloe vera, witch hazel, and persimmon extract to help soothe your pet’s ear, loosen and clear up ear wax and dirty discharge, prevent ear infection, reduce itchiness, and eliminate unpleasant odour. Witch hazel is a natural medicinal plant with strong antioxidant and astringent properties that helps remove excess oil from the skin, break up wax, and reduce swelling and inflammation. Japanese persimmon extract has been used for centuries for its anti-bacterial and odour neutralizing benefits.  It contains condensed tannins proven to effectively eliminate a wide range of foul body odour and is effective in controlling bacteria growth including Staphylococcus and Pseudomonas- bacteria commonly found with dog ear infection. 100% natural.  PH 7. Alcohol-free.

HOW TO USE

Make sure that your pet is in a relaxed position before you begin.  Squeeze the ear cleaning solution to fill the ear canal and massage gently at the base of the ear for 20 seconds.  Let your pet shake their head.  Gently wipe away visible debris and discharge from ear canal with cotton ball or tissue.  Repeat once a week.

INGREDIENTS

Purified Water, Alcohol-free Witch Hazel Extract, Persimmon Extract, Sorbitan Oleate, Decylglucoside Crosspolymer, Aloe Vera, Natural Preservative, Essential Oils of Frankincense & Geranium

name: Doggy Potion Tear Stain Remover - 120ml
description:
DETAILS

Doggy Potion Tear Stain Remover with organic edelweiss extract is an all-natural gentle tear stain remover that helps to easily remove stubborn tear stains and reduce discoloration of fur around the eyes and to soothe and nourish the skin around the eyes of dogs and cats. It contains very mild natural cleanser made from Pea Protein and Oat Amino safe for use around the eye area. Edelweiss is a flower native to European Alps especially in Switzerland and Austria found at very high altitudes, between 1,800 meters and 3,000 meters, where it defies extreme environmental conditions.  Its extract has strong anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to soothe, nourish, and stimulate the generation of new skin cells and enhance the skin protective barrier. Repeated use will assist in preventing the reoccurrence of stains and fur discoloration. 100% Natural

HOW TO USE

Wet the cotton wool with Tear Stain Remover solution and gently wipe away stains using clean wool for each eye. Remove any residue with dry clean cotton wool.  Apply twice a week to prevent reoccurrence.

INGREDIENTS

Purified Water, Chamomile Flower Water, Sodium Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Pea Protein, Sodium Lauroyl Oat Amino Acids, Persimmon Extract, Edelweiss Extract, Natural Preservative

name: Rechargeable Pets UV Light
description:
Fungus detector for pets


A pet fungus detector is a device used to detect fungi on your pet's skin. It works by emitting ultraviolet light, which causes the fungus to glow.

Features of pet fungus detector:
Easy to use: just turn it on and point it at your pet's skin.
Accurate: Shows you even the smallest spots of fungus.
Fast: gives you results in seconds.
Safe: Does not harm your pet.
VERSATILE: Can be used on all types of pets, including dogs, cats and rabbits.


Benefits:
Early detection of fungi: Early detection of fungi helps you treat your pet faster and prevents the spread of infection.
Peace of Mind: Gives you peace of mind by knowing whether or not your pet has fungus.
Save money: Early detection of fungi can help you save money by reducing treatment costs.

How to use pet fungus detector:
Turn off the lights in the room.
Turn on your pet fungus detector.
Point the light at your pet's skin.
Look for spots of fluorescence (glowing).
If you find any fluorescent spots, take your pet to the vet immediately.

name: Pet Tumbler Feeder
description:
Walking Food Dispenser Toy
This walking dispenser toy works just like a roly-poly toy. You can put food into the toy through the transparent barn lid, Then close the lid. When a small tap forced on the robot shaped toy, it will walk and dispense food out. In this way, the robot toy can keep the pet's attention and practice IQ.

In the front of this pet toy there is a food dispenser hole. The size of the food leak hole is suitable for most of the pet food, kiddle and treats to fall out when this robot is moving. The transparent barn lid can be open and closed for you to put inside the food/treat inside and turn off. Due to the self gravity system, this robot shaped toy will easily move once your pet tap it and dispense food/treat. Your dog/cat get treat as reward through their own effort.

 

Very Easy to Operate
1.Open the barn lid in the front of the robert.

2.Put into the dog food/treat/kiddle inside.

3.Close the barn lid and place the toy in front of your dog on a flat and clean surface.

TIPS: When you try to open the barn lid, please pres the barn lid to the inside while opening the "door".

 

What can your pet get from this toy?

Form good eating habit
When using this toy, your pet will get reward of food dispensing when touch the toy. Helps him/her to form the eating habit to eat slowly. Keeps him/her health and active.

Your pet will have fun chasing
The toy will move forward when touching the body, it raise the curiosity of your pet to play with it. Also with the self gravity system, the robot is like a roly-poly toy. It will not roll over. Your pet will have fun chasing behind it.

Share toy for your cat and dog, enhance teir relationship
This toy is good for your cat and dog. When they are sharing a toy, they will have very good interaction and enhance their relationship.

  • [FUN TOY] This dog tumbler puzzle toy has a built in self gravity system. With the fun roller design and robot appearance, this pet toy can catch their attention and have fun.
  • [IMPROVING IQ] Pets will get treats as reward after they have tapped this slow food toy dispensor.After several times, they will have a sense to get food with own effort, improbing IQ.
  • [EATING SLOWLY] Regularly using this toy will cultivate the dog/cat's behavior to eat slowly. They get food from this slow feed dispensor and eating slowly. Helping them to keep fit and health.
  • [INTERACT TOY for DOGS and CATS] You can interact with your cats and dogs at the same time, experincing DOUBLE fun with this interact toy with your dog and cat.Enhancing your relationship.
